when.text: no matching platform setting is found

rules.text: If no matching platform setting is found, a new platform setting is saved (platform name becomes "FerryGo"; support email becomes "support@ferrygo.com"; commission rate becomes 10; payout schedule becomes "WEEKLY").
The matching schedules are changed: available seats goes down by seats.

when.text: result count is not 1

rules.text: If result count is not 1, the schedule is changed: available seats goes up by seats.

These happen together: a new booking is saved, new tickets are saved, a new payment is saved, the matching schedules are changed and the schedule is changed. If one of them fails, none of them is kept.
